metaDescription: DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.

excerpt: DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as DK 8282S or Dekalb 8282S. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2021 as NSIC 2021 GMCn 75. Bayer Crop Science bred it. It takes 105 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 9.11 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn

blocks.caption: Key facts of DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn takes 105 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 9.11 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 110 days.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 16.33 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 80.61 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** No ceiling given: Bayer claims 1.7 t/ha more than market standard hybrids, shelling recovery 84 percent.

**Traits in the seed:** VT Double PRO RIB Complete (Bayer's trait code VT2PRIB): two Bt proteins with different modes of action against Asian corn borer, fall armyworm, corn earworm and common cutworm, its registered events are MON 89034 x NK603, so the plant also tolerates glyphosate (Roundup). The bag holds 95 percent traited seed and 5 percent refuge seed already mixed, so no separate refuge block has to be planted.
**Stand:** 83,000 to 90,000 plants per ha, furrows 60 cm, hills 18 or 20 cm.
Semi erect plant, ears set at medium height.
Good tolerance to stalk rots and to leaf diseases.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: featured first on Bayer's current Philippine Dekalb list, a site banner calls it Dekalb's newest hybrid. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete corn

It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is DK 8282S the same as DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete?
items.a: Yes. DK 8282S is another name for DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete, registered as NSIC 2021 GMCn 75. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 105 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 9.11 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
It is recommended for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of DEKALB®8282S VTDoublePRO RIB Complete?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
